description:
Advances: ancora.derive

Ready-for: investigate

Symptom:
`mix spec.status` on ChapterSpot/tsql_parser main (0542f06, Ancora 1.3.0) reports 172 unresolved calls for tsql_parser.rendering and 94 for tsql_parser.parsing. 126 of rendering's sit in test/support/gen_expr.ex, which does `import StreamData` and calls bind/2, member_of/1, map/2 and list_of/2. MIX_ENV=test gives the same counts. Compare.set_findings skips shrink for carriers with unresolved calls, so a test there that stops calling a production function reports no shrink.

Evidence:
- `mix spec.check --base HEAD --verbose | grep unresolved_calls` on that commit lists 279 `unqualified at` entries across the four subjects.
- Ancora.Derive.context/4 accepts `external_modules:`, and Resolver.dispose_imports/4 has a `:drop` branch for calls a non-member import exports (lib/ancora/derive/resolver.ex:388-426).
- Gate (lib/ancora/gate.ex:400) and Status (lib/ancora/status.ex:77) never pass `external_modules:`, so external_exports is always empty and every call through a dependency import lands in unresolved.

Why now:
Property-test generators commonly `import StreamData`, so adopters see large unresolved counts and lose shrink detection on exactly the carriers that exercise the most code.

Suspected cause (hypothesis):
Wiring `external_modules:` means loading the target's dependency bytecode, which can run @on_load hooks. ancora.decision.no_execution_no_state allows export lookups only in Ancora's own dependencies, so that route conflicts with the charter. A source-only rule may be enough: membership is derived from source, so when every admitted import that could supply f/a is a non-member module, the call cannot be a project binding and can be dropped. Unexpanded `use` injection stays unresolved, per ancora.derive.unqualified_ladder. Untested. /investigate should check soundness when a member import is also admitted and its module has macro-generated functions.
title: Calls through imported dependencies are always unresolved
